pairs: Et dixit Elias Thesbites de habitatoribus Galaad ad Achab:
And Elijah the Tishbite, from the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab,
“As the Lord lives, the God of Israel,
in cujus conspectu sto, si erit annis his ros et pluvia,
in whose sight I stand, there shall not be dew or rain during these years,
except by the words of my mouth.”
Et factum est verbum Domini ad eum,
And the word of the Lord came to him,
and hide at the torrent Cherith,
And there you shall drink from the torrent.
corvisque præcepi ut pascant te ibi.
And I have instructed the ravens to feed you there.”
he went and acted in accord with the word of the Lord.
he settled by the torrent Cherith,
Corvi quoque deferebant ei panem et carnes mane,
And the ravens carried bread and flesh to him in the morning,
and likewise bread and flesh in the evening.
And he drank from the torrent.
Post dies autem siccatus est torrens:
But after some days, the torrent dried up.
For it had not rained upon the earth.
Factus est ergo sermo Domini ad eum,
Then the word of the Lord came to him,
and go to Zarephath of the Sidonians,
præcepi enim ibi mulieri viduæ ut pascat te.
For I have instructed a widowed woman there to feed you.”
He rose up and went away to Zarephath.
And when he had arrived at the gate of the city,
he saw the widowed woman collecting wood,
apparuit ei mulier vidua colligens ligna,
“Give me a little water in a vessel,
Da mihi paululum aquæ in vase ut bibam.
And as she was going to bring it,
et buccellam panis in manu tua.
a morsel of bread in your hand.”
nisi quantum pugillus capere potest farinæ in hydria,
except a handful of flour in a jar, and a little oil in a bottle. See,
I am collecting a couple of sticks,
en colligo duo ligna ut ingrediar et faciam illum mihi et filio meo,
so that I may go in and make it for myself and my son,
so that we may eat it and die.”
sed vade, et fac sicut dixisti:
But go and do as you have said. Yet truly,
verumtamen mihi primum fac de ipsa farinula subcinericium panem parvulum,
first make for me, from the same flour, a little bread baked under ashes,
tibi autem et filio tuo facies postea.
Then afterward, make some for yourself and for your son.
Hæc autem dicit Dominus Deus Israël:
For thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
‘The jar of flour will not fail,
nor the bottle of oil be diminished,
usque ad diem in qua Dominus daturus est pluviam super faciem terræ.
until the day when the Lord will grant rain upon the face of the earth.’”
and acted in accord with the word of Elijah.
the jar of flour did not fail,
et lecythus olei non est imminutus,
and the bottle of oil was not diminished,
juxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat in manu Eliæ.
in accord with the word of the Lord, which he had spoken by the hand of Elijah.
Now it happened that, after these things,
the son of the woman who was the mother of the family became ill.
And the sickness was very powerful,
ita ut non remaneret in eo halitus.
so that no breath remained in him.
“What is there between you and me,
so that my iniquities would be remembered,
and so that you would put to death my son?”
And he took him from her bosom,
et portavit in cœnaculum ubi ipse manebat,
and he carried him to an upper room, where he himself was staying.
And he placed him on his own bed.
And he cried out to the Lord,
etiam ne viduam apud quam ego utcumque sustentor,
have you even afflicted the widow by whom I am, in a sense,
sustained, so that you would put to death her son?”
And he stretched himself out beside the boy three times.
atque mensus est super puerum tribus vicibus,
And he cried out to the Lord
let the soul of this boy,
anima pueri hujus in viscera ejus.
And the Lord heeded the voice of Elijah.
et reversa est anima pueri intra eum,
And the soul of the boy returned to him,
et deposuit eum de cœnaculo in inferiorem domum,
and he brought him down from the upper room to the lower part of the house.
And he gave him to his mother.
And the woman said to Elijah:
Nunc in isto cognovi quoniam vir Dei es tu,
“By this, I now realize that you are a man of God,
et verbum Domini in ore tuo verum est.
and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is true.”
